item.title: Young girl finds whale stranded on Australian beach
item.description: The humpback whale later successfully freed itself after the tide rose in Queensland, Australia.

item.title: Drone captures devastating aftermath of Spokane wildfires
item.description: The aerial footage shows homes destroyed down to their foundations, with burned cars still parked in some driveways.

item.title: Watch: Tide of rubbish blankets Philippines river
item.description: Workers in Manila waded through the river, collecting waste that washed in during days of heavy rain.

item.title: Watch: Was Trump smuggled out of Air Force One in a catering truck?
item.description: US media reports say the president secretly left via a catering truck to avoid a threat to his life from Iran.

item.title: How a 97-year-old escaped deadly Indian floods on a banana log raft
item.description: A 97-year-old's dramatic rescue captures how Assam's floods are reaching places once thought safe.

item.title: Anguish of Colombian brother at rubble of building being searched for earthquake survivors
item.description: BBC Mundo has gone to the site of Torres del Limonar, a collapsed building in Cali where rescue workers fight to free survivors.

item.title: Inside the Secret Service 'shell game' to hide US presidents in plain sight
item.description: Elaborate deception operations and decoys are often used to deceive potential threats to the US president.

item.title: These seaside apartments were a ghost city - then police say scammers moved in
item.description: Malaysia's Forest City was pitched as "paradise" but last month police raided it over alleged scam operations.

item.title: Canada flight cancelled after child refuses to wear seat belt
item.description: The incident has sparked a debate over child safety and discipline on commercial planes.

item.title: Thailand suspends new gun permits after mass shooting
item.description: Authorities promise tough new laws in the country, which has high levels of firearms ownership.

item.title: Russia releases former US Marine reported in poor health
item.description: Robert Gilman, who was arrested in 2022, was left in "life-threatening condition" after being subjected to "harsh and abusive treatment", his family says.

item.title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
item.description: The ex-president is convicted of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.

item.title: Luigi Mangione murder trial to have anonymous jury
item.description: The judge overseeing the state murder trial ruled the 12-person jury would remain anonymous because of the intense media spotlight on the case.

item.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
item.description: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed seven people - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.

item.title: Former judge removed by Orbán elected Hungarian president
item.description: Since taking office in early May, the new Hungarian government has lost no time dismantling Viktor Orbán's legacy.

item.title: France bans unsolicited telemarketing calls
item.description: Cold calling is coming to an end in France, with one consumer group calling the ban a "small revolution".

item.title: New Zealand PM survives second leadership challenge ahead of election
item.description: Christopher Luxon says he has "full support" of his party, after a vote of confidence 12 weeks before a general election.

item.title: Bondi Beach shooting hero's assault charges dropped by police
item.description: Police charged Ahmed al Ahmed in June after an alleged incident with his father at a Sydney home.

item.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
item.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo marries long-time partner Georgina Rodríguez
item.description: The Portuguese superstar has posted an image of two hands - presumed to be his on top of his wife's - both wearing wedding rings.

item.title: Baby Shark Boy set to make K-pop debut
item.description: The boy from the most-watched YouTube video of all time is now 17 years old, and wants to be a K-pop star.

item.title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
item.description: US Central Command says its helicopter hit the engine room of a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.

item.title: Trump's dramatic plane swap hints at personal stakes of Iran war
item.description: It marks another striking episode in the turbulent history of his relationship with Iran, writes the BBC's Anthony Zurcher.

item.title: Trump says he switched planes after Nato summit because of possible threat
item.description: But the president says the jet he boarded instead was at "greater risk" than the decoy Air Force One.

item.title: Rescuers scramble for survivors with 180 dead in Colombia earthquake
item.description: Colombia experienced a number of aftershocks on Tuesday, as efforts continued to free survivors trapped in rubble and buildings.
